summary: Marex Group Limited furnished a Form 6-K reporting its Q2 2026 earnings results and condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes record revenue of $695.8 million and adjusted profit before tax of $165.9 million for Q2, plus a $35.1 million gain on disposal of Winterflood's custody business noted within profit after tax. No special-situation corporate actions such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic reviews are announced; it is a routine earnings disclosure. What to watch: continued execution on the stated acquisition pipeline and margin expansion.
